verdict.rationale: There is evidence of a general OpenAI API reference with selectable language runnable code samples (codex-docs-29), but this is part of the broader OpenAI Responses API docs rather than an interactive reference specific to the Codex agent/CLI product itself, and no other evidence ties an interactive, runnable API playground to Codex's own capabilities (e.g., MCP tools, CLI commands). missing for 10: a Codex-specific interactive API/tool reference, evidence of runnable examples for Codex's own CLI/agent APIs, independent corroboration of an interactive playground.
